thread:
Diego (Growth): Heads-up: webinar + benchmark launch slated for next Tue. Need a concise SEO action list today: keyword targets, JSON-LD (Event+FAQ), internal linking plan for launch posts, and a redirects/canonical mapping for the gated benchmark asset. Can we finalize by EOD?
Priya (SEO): I can own schema + keywords. Plan: 2 primary keywords (benchmark insights, inference benchmark) + 5 supporting longtails. Will push a tiny keyword doc to the drive.
Sam (DevOps): I'll do redirects and smoke tests. Quick question: do we want the PDF under /downloads or /gated? preference for /downloads/benchmark-v1.pdf so it looks stable.
Diego (Growth): OK go with /downloads/benchmark-v1.pdf as the gated slug. Public summary stays at /benchmark-summary. Need 301s from old landing URLs.
Lucy (Content): Internal linking plan: 1) Insert a contextual link from all launch posts to /benchmark-summary using anchor text "inference benchmark"; 2) Add a prominent CTA block on the product docs page pointing to webinar register; 3) Ensure related-posts widget surfaces the summary and webinar landing. I'll update 6 posts.
Priya (SEO): Minimal JSON-LD FAQ for the summary page (devs can paste into head):
```
{"@context":"https://schema.org","@type":"FAQPage","mainEntity":[{"@type":"Question","name":"What data is in the benchmark?","acceptedAnswer":{"@type":"Answer","text":"Aggregated latency, throughput, and cost metrics across model families and configs."}},{"@type":"Question","name":"Is the full dataset downloadable?","acceptedAnswer":{"@type":"Answer","text":"The complete report is gated; a public summary is available on the page."}}]}
```
Priya (SEO): Event JSON-LD stub for webinar (replace startDate/endDate):
```
{"@context":"https://schema.org","@type":"Event","name":"Redwood Inference Benchmark Webinar","startDate":"2026-04-14T16:00:00Z","description":"Walkthrough of benchmark findings and Q&A for engineers.","location":{"@type":"VirtualLocation","url":"https://redwood.example.com/webinar/register"}}
```
Sam (DevOps): Redirects I'll add to infra (nginx snippet):
```
# launch redirects
return 301 https://redwood.example.com/benchmark-summary; # /benchmark -> summary handled in server block
rewrite ^/benchmark/pdf$ /downloads/benchmark-v1.pdf permanent; # pdf moved to gated slug
rewrite ^/webinar$ /webinar/register?src=launch permanent; # landing short -> register
```
Sam (DevOps): Curl/smoke test patterns I'll include in deploy notes: 
```
# expect 301 location header
curl -sI https://redwood.example.com/benchmark | grep -i Location
# check gated PDF is 200 behind form handling (post-deploy)
curl -I https://redwood.example.com/downloads/benchmark-v1.pdf
```
PublishBot: audit: duplicate-title warning on /blog/launch-post-2 and /blog/launch-post-5. Recommend unique H1s + meta titles.
Lucy (Content): I'll rewrite titles and tighten metas to 50-60 chars. Also will add canonical column to the content spreadsheet: old_url -> canonical_url -> noindex flag.
Diego (Growth): Important canonical rules: summary page canonical -> /benchmark-summary. Gated PDF should be noindex, follow and set X-Robots-Tag for downloads. Also ensure OG:title and OG:image point at summary page for social shares.
Priya (SEO): Pagination note: for multi-page launch series keep rel=prev/next. If content duplication is too high, canonical to page 1 of the series. Add to checklist.
Sam (DevOps): I'll include a CSV mapping of redirects in the PR: columns: source_url,target_url,status_code,notes. Will also run linkcheck after deploy and post findings.
Diego (Growth): Deliverables by EOD: Priya -> keyword doc + JSON-LD snippets; Sam -> redirects CSV + curl tests; Lucy -> updated internallink list + meta/title edits; I'll finalize email subject/CTA copy.
PublishBot: scheduled check: link-scan at 09:00 UTC tomorrow; will DM failures.
Diego (Growth): Great. Once all artifacts are in the shared folder I'll sign off and queue the deploy. Thanks everyone :white_check_mark:
